name: Lee's Membership Hierarchy
author: Lee

sections.description:
This plugin enables site administrators to manage users in a structured hierarchy with additional metadata and logic.

Key Features:
– Assign users to organisations
– Set membership types (e.g., Member, Admin, Delegate)
– Define expiry dates (organisation-wide or user-specific)
– Status control (Active, Inactive, or custom)
– Optional inheritance of expiry/status from organisations
– Admin interface for managing organisations and members
– Highlighted user lists for active/inactive members

Ideal for associations, federated networks, or multi-tiered membership models.

Usage

Navigate to Users > Membership List to view and manage all assigned members.
Use Settings > Membership Hierarchy to customise the labels and options.

Shortcode

No front-end shortcodes are included in version 1.0.0.

License

This plugin is released under the GPLv2 or later.
See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Membership Hierarchy to configure labels, types, and statuses
  4. Use Users > Membership List to manage assigned users
  5. Edit individual user profiles to assign them to organisations and set membership options
sections.faq:
Can I define custom statuses or membership types?

Yes! You can customise both under Settings > Membership Hierarchy.

Can expiry dates be inherited from organisations?

Yes. You can choose whether expiry is user-specific or inherited.

Does this plugin affect WordPress roles?

No. It works alongside roles — using metadata for additional membership structure.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Organisation management, user profile enhancements, expiry/status logic, and admin pages.
